name: npctalk
description: Talk to the town NPCs: walk up to one and a text box opens; they answer in character (LLM). !talk opens the nearest one.
author: pooper

model.description: Model name sent to the proxy

proximity.description: Open a conversation by walking up to an NPC (off: press E on them)

radius.description: Units from a standing NPC that start a conversation

cooldown-seconds.description: After Cancel, seconds before that NPC speaks to you again
